qrgen.mdd: I will stamp you a little square!
qrgen.ph.name: Name
qrgen.status.idle: Type something and the QR code appears right away.
qrgen.status.scan: We read the code we just made, to be sure it works.
qrgen.status.tooLong: That is too long. Lower the error correction level or shorten the content.
qrgen.scan.unsupported: This browser could not check it (the QR code itself was made).
qrgen.scan.ok: We read it back — it scans fine.
qrgen.scan.mismatch: It scans, but the content differs. Shrink the logo or raise error correction to H.
qrgen.scan.fail: The code we made does not scan — shrink the logo, raise error correction to H, or increase the contrast.
qrgen.copy.unsupported: This browser cannot copy images. Save it as PNG instead.
